metadata.comment: Ark bills per output token, not per second: tokens = width * height * 24 * seconds / 1024, so a per-second rate per resolution tier is exact for the 16:9 geometry Ark publishes (1280x720 is 21600 tokens/s). List 70 CNY per million tokens at 480p and 720p and 77 at 1080p without a video input, matching Ark's per-resolution table and its 1080p 16:9 example of 3.74 CNY/s, converted at 7.0 CNY/USD like the other volcengine entries. Accepts up to 50 reference assets (30 images, 10 videos, 10 audios) and clips of 4-30s; per-asset billing beyond the free allowance is not encoded. Requests with a video input bill at a lower rate per token and are rejected, since their cost is not known at create time. provider_specific_entry.volcengine_video_frames is the frame Ark renders per resolution tier and ratio, verified with ffprobe at 480p for every ratio and at 720p for 16:9 and 4:3; the other 720p ratios are from the Seedance 2.0 model card.

List 46 CNY per million tokens at 480p and 720p, 51 at 1080p, and 26 at 4k without a video input, matching Ark's per-resolution table and its 1080p and 4k 16:9 examples of 2.48 and 5.05 CNY/s, converted at 7.0 CNY/USD like the other volcengine entries. Clips of 4-15s; 4k is exclusive to this tier. V2 async task API. Pay-as-you-go list price $0.08/s at 768P and $0.13/s at 2K, plus $0.04 per input image beyond the first 5. Audio input is free. Reference video input is rejected, since MiniMax bills its duration only after the create call.

V2 async task API, fast tier. Pay-as-you-go list price $0.05/s at 480P and $0.08/s at 768P; no 2K. Plus $0.074 per input image beyond the first 2. Audio input is free. Reference video input is rejected, since MiniMax bills its duration only after the create call.
Output: 20/30/68 credits per second at 480p/720p/1080p @ $0.01 per credit; input video billed additionally at 10/15/34 credits per input second and the 80 credit minimum per task are not modeled
